# SEO-312: Revalidate llms.txt entries when canonical URLs change

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Domain | `llms-txt` |
| Category | `EMERGING_GEO` |
| Minimum level | `RECOMMENDED` |
| Severity | `LOW` |
| Impact | `LOW` |
| Change safety | `REVIEW_REQUIRED` |
| Evidence tier | `D` |
| Confidence | `MEDIUM` |

## Statement

After any change to the canonical address of a listed page, the entry is updated in the same change, and every listed location is confirmed to still resolve without redirection.

## Rationale

A hand-maintained inventory rots silently, and an entry left pointing at a moved page turns the file into a list of stale addresses that nobody notices because nothing reads it back.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_llms_txt"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Regenerate the file from the canonical route set as part of the build, so a URL change updates the entry without anyone remembering to. Fail the build when a listed location does not resolve directly.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Request each listed location and report any that redirects or fails, comparing the set against the current canonical route set.
- Evidence: `HTTP_STATUS`, `REDIRECT_CHAIN`, `BUILD_OUTPUT`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `AI_ASSISTANT_RETRIEVAL`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: This is maintenance hygiene for a file the site chose to publish. It carries no discoverability claim, and a site that finds the maintenance unjustified is better off removing the file than leaving it stale.
